parameters.query:
-- Tous les passages des pages retenues en entier (mode config), dans l'ordre de la page.
select c.id as chunk_id, c.source_id, s.kind, s.title, c.breadcrumb, c.url, s.url_fr, c.content
from knowledge_chunks c join knowledge_sources s on s.id = c.source_id
where c.source_id = any(array(select jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb))::uuid[])
order by c.source_id, c.ordinal
